text:
Morgan: Heads up — our periodic access-review sample flagged some KMS-admin grants in Prod last night. Need a quick sanity-check before the quarterly cert. @Jess @Sam any chance you can look?

audit-bot: Scheduled entitlement-scan finished: 4 principals with KMS admin roles in project/redwood-prod. Report: https://redwood.internal/sec/reports/3611112222 :page_facing_up:

Jess: On it. Which principals are we talking about? paste the list or a snippet pls. Also did this coincide with any deploys/infra changes?

Morgan: Quick paste from the scan output:```
svc-backup-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com  roles/cloudkms.admin  granted: 2025-12-01
svc-infra-ops@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.admin granted: 2026-01-08
svc-ml-featurestore@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.admin granted: 2026-02-10
svc-lambda-legacy-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.admin granted: 2024-09-15
```

Sam: I ran a quick cross-check with deployment audit. First three are expected (backup rotation, infra key manager, ml featurestore). The last one (svc-lambda-legacy-prod) looks orphaned — owner tag missing, last activity 2025-06.

Sam: Proposed remediation: 1) remove active grant (disable binding) with a 48h hold window, 2) add to SEC-4321 ticket for owner outreach, 3) if no owner within 48h, remove permanently and patch infra TF state.

Irene: Oncall +1 to the 48h hold. Make sure to snapshot audit logs and preserve evidence for attestation. Also add the step to the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-entitlement-cleanup 

Jess: I'll prepare the export. Use this audit log filter and export to GCS before making config changes:```json
{
  "resource.type": "k8s_container",
  "query": "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svc-lambda-legacy-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" OR resource.labels.service_account=\"svc-lambda-legacy-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"",
  "time_range": {"start": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "end": "2026-02-15T00:00:00Z"}
}
```

Morgan: :thumbsup: I'll disable the binding in staging first to validate no runtime fallout. Note: binding is currently managed in terraform (infra/kms/roles.tf) so we'll need a PR to remove or mark owner. @Sam can you open the infra PR and add a TF drift note?

Sam: Opening draft PR now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 (draft) — includes plan, tfstate note, and rollback steps. :eyes:

audit-bot: Action recorded: ticket SEC-4321 created; evidence exported to gs://sec-evidence/3611112222/; retention policy: 180d.

Morgan: Great work. I'll update the access-review sheet and calendar entry for quarterly cert. We'll close this loop after the 48h hold unless anyone objects.
